mara (Finance): Quick heads-up: we're rolling out a consolidated invoice digest next week that groups per-route microcharges into a single, human-readable section. This should cut down CFO back-and-forth for customers doing per-route optimizations.

sam (Billing Eng): TL;DR: single digest, opt-in CSV export for minute-level breakdowns, and a 48h soft grace window for meter corrections. Not switching off current invoices, just adding a new view + export.

devin (Platform): Who's the target cohort for opt-in? startups / trial accounts only or everyone?

mara (Finance): Initially beta for orgs on self-serve and Starter plans; we'll open to all accounts after a 2-week pilot and feedback loop.

anya (Legal): Confirmed we ran the privacy check — CSV has no raw prompt content or embeddings, only route IDs, aggregated token counts, and cost cents.

sam (Billing Eng): Example CSV header we'll emit for the opt-in export:
```
invoice_id,org_id,period_start,period_end,total_usd,route_id,minute_bucket_iso,token_count,charge_cents
```

oliver (CEO): Nice. Does this change any overage semantics? We should be explicit to customers.

mara (Finance): No change to overage caps/charges. The only policy tweak: a 48-hour "metering-grace" for self-serve, where ops can request quick replays for missing inbound usage. Enterprise customers keep existing SLA-driven dispute windows.

sam (Billing Eng): Also adding a soft flag for "detailed-minute-buckets" that customers can enable on the console. It increases billing granularity (and size of exports) but helps cost attribution. It defaults to off.

devin (Platform): Rollout plan? feature flags?

sam (Billing Eng): Flags + phased rollout: beta -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 14 days. We'll monitor exporter latency and S3 costs.

billing-bot: deploy started: billing-service:v3.9.2 -> prod (canary 10%) — runbook: /runbooks/billing-digest-rollout

mara (Finance): Communication plan: external blog post + help center KB with sample CSV + email to active billing contacts. Internal playbook in #support for handling export requests.

oliver (CEO): Make sure sales has a one-pager. This is a good upsell for dedicated customers (detailed billing helps justify Reserved Capacity).

anya (Legal): Also adding a short clause to TOS clarifying what the new export contains. Draft ready, pinged legal-review.

sam (Billing Eng): Ops checklist for tomorrow:
- Enable feature-flag for beta orgs
- Run migration that creates digest entries (non-blocking)
- Validate CSV schema on sample invoices
- Watch job queue latency < 1s per invoice

mara (Finance): Metrics we'll track: #customers opting in, avg CSV size, disputes opened within 7 days, and NPS signal from finance contacts.

devin (Platform): Noted. I'll attach dashboards to the rollout channel and add tracing for exporter paths.

mara (Finance): Customer-facing blurb (draft): "New: consolidated invoice digest + optional minute-level exports. Streamlines cost review and helps reconcile per-route charges. Opt-in available in Billing Settings." Feedback welcome.

sam (Billing Eng): + :thumbsup: from engineering. Will add sample link and support snippet.

oliver (CEO): Thanks team — ship it carefully. :rocket: 

billing-bot: deploy success: billing-service:v3.9.2 canary -> healthy on 10% (2026-03-23T16:45:27Z)

mara (Finance): We'll open the beta sign-up form at 0900 PT tomorrow. If you want to be on the internal pilot, DM me. :tada:
